ValidationRule.description: Checks if "Contact Role" is associated with opportunity when moving to Verbal Commit and Closed Won.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( OR ( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Verbal Commit")), ISBLANK(Contact_Roles__c), ISCHANGED(StageName), RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Partner", RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Organic_Growth", RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Renewal", RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Expansion_Upsell" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add at least one contact to Contact Role section.
